components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 3.5rem; padding: 1rem 2rem; border-radius: 2px; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Manrope Variable', sans-serif); font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-label { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; } .ds-btn svg { transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-gold, #e8b31a); color: #000; border: none; box-shadow: 0 14px 40px -18px rgb(232 179 26 / 0.7); } .ds-btn-primary::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 30%, rgb(255 248 230 / 0.7) 50%, transparent 70%); transform: translateX(-120%); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-amber, #f6c83a); box-shadow: 0 22px 60px -18px rgb(232 179 26 / 0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::after { transform: translateX(120%); transition: transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #e8b31a; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

narrative.northStar: The House Style of a Label
narrative.overview:
BOA reads like a record label or a premium streamer's editorial house: the slate is the hero, set in poster-scale condensed caps over real footage. The ground is near-black, the type is stark white, and one deep gold carries the logo, the primary action and single accent words. Nothing is soft or tasteful-startup; there is no gradient wash behind the copy and no frosted card holding it.

Depth comes from the room, not from the furniture. Heavy fog drifts across every page in screen blend, a warm key light breathes behind headlines, and film grain re-rolls over everything like a projected print. Surfaces themselves are hard-edged slabs with hairline borders. Motion is held and deliberate: entrances hold, commit, then settle; hovers answer quickly and ease out.

Media is never an empty box. Every production frame is a full-bleed tile that pushes in on hover, and every trailer starts as its poster with a glowing gold play disc.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground (obsidian), stark white type, one deep gold accent.
Anton poster caps for every heading; Manrope for reading; JetBrains Mono only for production metadata.
Fixed drifting fog, warm spotlight and film grain as the atmosphere; no vignette.
Hard 2px corners everywhere except the status dot and the play disc.

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only hue. It marks the logo, the one primary action in view and single accent words; a second accent colour does not exist.

rules.name: The Flat Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is flat white or flat gold. No gradient text, no clipped-background fills, no tinted overlays across headlines.

rules.name: The Metadata Below Rule
rules.body: Nothing sits above a heading: no kicker, no eyebrow, no section number. Metadata and context lines go below the title, between it and the lede.

rules.name: The Mono Is Data Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono appears only on production metadata, counts and measurements. Every other label is Manrope 700 in tracked caps.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Headings are Anton 400 at 0.01em, enforced globally. Never fake-bold, condense or negatively track display type.

rules.name: The Screen Blend Rule
rules.body: Fog, smoke, spotlight and light bleed always composite with screen blend so they glow on the dark base. Never switch them to normal blending.

rules.name: The No Vignette Rule
rules.body: No darkening overlay frames the viewport; it greys the edges of display type. Darkness comes from the ground and from per-image bottom gradients only.

rules.name: The Hard Corner Rule
rules.body: 2px on every control and container. A pill or rounded card is off-system; only the status dot and the play disc are round.

dos: **Do** set every heading in Anton 400 caps, flat white or flat gold, with one accent phrase in gold at most.
**Do** put metadata below the title: tracked Manrope label or gold mono meta between the heading and the lede.
**Do** run entrances on easeInOutExpo (0.87, 0, 0.13, 1) and hover or feedback on cine ease-out (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
**Do** treat media tiles the same way: image to 1.05x, frame darkens, CTA fades up, and the CTA always shows on hover:none.
**Do** render every YouTube embed as a video facade: poster plus gold play disc, iframe on click.
**Do** keep hero copy above the fog (z 41) and let only the grain pass over it.
**Do** use 2px corners on buttons, chips, inputs, panels and tiles.
donts: **Don't** place kickers, eyebrows or section numbers above a heading.
**Don't** use JetBrains Mono for UI labels, form labels or prose; it is for production metadata, counts and measurements only.
**Don't** use gradient text, a vignette overlay or any tint across display type.
**Don't** use pills or rounded cards; only the status dot and the play disc are round.
**Don't** use frosted glass cards; panels are solid ink slabs with a hairline.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue or a serif italic.
**Don't** composite fog or light layers with normal blending.
